title: StreamMessage
description: One message on the live SSE stream (ADR 0003). The data shape depends on type. claim and verdict carry a claim. A claim is sent when its beat airs, with its final verdict if the Checker has finished or `checking` if not; a verdict follows when it finishes, and again when the auditor has a result, with the same verdict plus `audit`. seq is the order of sending; a reconnect resumes by seq only on a stream with no agent messages.

seq.description: Starts at 0 and increases by one per message; the SSE id.

span_id.description: On claim and verdict messages: the id of the beat's span in the match's trace.

state.description: focus: slow playback into a moment, and it says nothing about what is coming. freeze: the freeze frame of event_id follows and playback holds on it. notice: a message for the viewer (narration paused, verification unavailable) that changes nothing about playback.

speed.description: Match minutes per real second while cruising. Absent in focus and freeze.

event_id.description: The anchor event, on a freeze status only.
